prompts.workerWalkSE: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a production animation sprite sheet of the EXACT worker from the reference: same dark hair/beard face, cream rolled sleeves, sage vest, olive trousers, brown pack and yellow roll, brown boots, axe always in anatomical RIGHT hand. Transparent background. ONE fixed south-east facing, elevated orthographic camera 45 degrees as reference. Eight consecutive WALK cycle frames, 4 columns by 2 rows. This is motion in one direction, NOT different facings. Deliberate alternating stride: 1 left foot forward/right back heel raised; 2 left foot planted/right leg passing; 3 left stance/right knee moving ahead; 4 right foot forward/left back heel raised; 5 right foot planted/left leg passing; 6 right stance/left knee moving ahead; 7 left leading foot descends; 8 left heel approaching contact, blends to frame1. Visible left and right feet must really alternate positions. Body and backpack stay same size and proportions, small natural vertical bob, axe held low clear of legs. ALL eight figures, axe and backpack complete within their individual cell; reduce all figures to occupy just 70 percent of cell height and width, ample empty padding on EVERY side. Identical root location within cells, no ground/no shadows/no grid/no text. Broad warm painterly Vaelora shapes and the same fidelity as approved reference. No changes to costume, no duplicated static standing poses.
